source: I want to make an incremental game with the art style of persona 5. There should be a tokyo city view where you can see all of your investments and zoom in on individual ones. There should be a cafe, a doctor's office, a jazz club, a bar, an airsoft store, and a tarot reader for now as the investments

answers.ask: Should the city read as a few streets around the six businesses, or a full skyline with the investments picked out inside it?
answers.answer: Use a few compact Tokyo streets centered on the six businesses, so each investment is clearly visible and easy to zoom into.

answers.ask: What does the player actually do between purchases - is income passive, or is there something to click on each business?
answers.answer: Income should be passive; the player uses that income to purchase and upgrade the businesses. No additional clicking mechanic is required.

--- clarifications from the author ---
- [scale] Should the city read as a few streets around the six businesses, or a full skyline with the investments picked out inside it? Use a few compact Tokyo streets centered on the six businesses, so each investment is clearly visible and easy to zoom into.
- [goal] What does the player actually do between purchases - is income passive, or is there something to click on each business? Income should be passive; the player uses that income to purchase and upgrade the businesses. No additional clicking mechanic is required.
config.genre_evidence: "incremental game" where "Income should be passive" and the player "uses that income to purchase and upgrade the businesses." The compact Tokyo streets are a view for managing investments, not an exploration or combat space.
config.evidence: "incremental game" with "income passive" used to "purchase and upgrade the businesses" supports a shared progression-and-upgrade layout; no personal plots, vehicle operation, training, or layered mine is described.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Shared Persistent World: No personal plot at all — one common world everybody operates in together.

INCLUDE:
- Upgrades Bazaar: The central storefront zone — eggs, upgrades, progression shops — that every player has to keep coming back to.
- Purchase Gate: Physical walls blocking higher-tier zones that animate away, drop into the ground, or vanish when bought.
- Progression Circulation: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.
